relevant_laws.quote: When stopping is required at a railroad crossing the driver shall keep as far to the right of the highway as possible and shall not form two lanes of traffic unless the highway is marked for four or more lanes of traffic.
relevant_laws.relevance_type: direct railroad-crossing stopping position and two-lane formation duty
